title: NFDC Charter Deep Dive — The Missing Operating Constitution
adds: The Charter appears to be the people, membership and operating-governance constitution for a prosecutor-led, multi-agency center; it is not publicly shown to be the legal authority for every dataset, feed, analytic system, investigation or payment action. Six OIGs (USDA, DOL, HUD, VA, SBA, SSA) publicly call themselves signatories, but the signed text was not publicly retrievable through the cutoff. The Charter is operationally consequential but not the whole machine: data agreements, State MOUs, technical annexes, Privacy Act/SORN, system authorization, records schedules and case-specific rules still control what moves.
